caption: The drawing depicts a rural scene featuring several buildings, figures, trees, fences, and pieces of equipment rendered in colored thread. In the upper left, there is a large, dark blue house with multiple chimneys, white windows, and a brown roof, surrounded by leafless trees with bluish trunks and branches. Adjacent to the house on the right are brown and gray farm buildings with slanted roofs. Various tools, carts, and a red wagon are positioned outside these buildings. In the foreground, two human figures are present: one is guiding a brown plow pulled by a white horse in a tan field, and the other, dressed in red, appears to be walking nearby. A series of green and brown trees of differing sizes are scattered across the scene. The sky is light beige with gray diagonal stitch marks suggesting clouds. The bottom border of the drawing has a decorative geometric pattern in red and brown hues and a stitched inscription that reads: "ESTATE OF JOHN APPLETON IN THE YEAR 1851, MARKE(D) IN 1888." The entire composition is enclosed within a rectangular frame made from the stitching.
title: Yarn Picture
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
